International Coffee Organization collation of specialty-coffee definitions: SCA 80-point and 0 category-1 defects with at most 5 category-2 per 350 g; ITC standard/premium/specialty tiers; Brazilian, Colombian, Rwandan national tiers (Rwanda super specialty 90-100); processes washed, natural, honey, anaerobic as attributes

Hamburger Teespeicher black tea page: category menu is by processing type (Schwarztee, Grüntee, Weißer & Gelber Tee, Oolong, Pu Erh) then Früchtetee, Rooibos, Kräutertee; black tea is split by region (Assam, Darjeeling with First Flush / Second Flush, Nepal & Sikkim, Sri Lanka, China) and filters are Anbauregion, Anbauland, Jahrgangstee, Zubereitungsart (gaiwan, gongfu), Eigenschaften and Bio; page explains leaf sizes Flowery/Broken/Fannings/Dust and CTC

Tee Gschwendner black tea page: top nav Tee, Matcha, Zubehör; black tea filters are Teeart, Anbaugebiet (Assam, Ceylon, Darjeeling, Nilgiri, Nepal, Kenya, Ostfriesland ...), Anbaumethode (Bio, Naturland, TransFair), Attribute (First Flush, Second Flush, caffeine, cold brew) and Geschmacksrichtung; products carry grade strings such as FTGFOP, TGBOP, OP

Lupicia online store flavoured black tea page (breadcrumb お茶 > 紅茶 > フレーバード seen in the search excerpt of this URL): filters by package form (leaf tea in bag, leaf tea in tin, tea bags), seasonal and regional limited designs and price; flavoured black tea is its own category beside plain black tea

Ippodo Tea Global (Kyoto) all-products page with Filter and Sort; product handles on the page are prefixed by type (matcha, sencha, bancha, utensils, gift), so the shop sorts into matcha, sencha, bancha (hojicha, genmaicha, kuki hojicha), teabags/gifts and utensils; items carry a Light/Balanced character label and seasonal tags

The Tea Spot herbal tea collection: filters Tea Type (herbal, green), Caffeine Level (caffeine-free/decaf), Flavor (citrus, floral, fruity, ginger, minty, spiced, unflavored, vanilla); herbal teas called tisanes and sold as single herbs and blends

EdelTee shop home: quick links Grüner Tee, Schwarzer Tee, Matcha, Kräutertee, Rooibos, Teezubehör and Kaffee as separate top-level branches; text lists Oolong, Pu-Erh, Früchtetee and Rooibos as further tea groups

ISO 20715:2023 Tea classification of tea types: six basic types by processing and aeration (black ISO 3720, green ISO 11287, white ISO/TR 12591, oolong ISO 20716, dark, yellow); scented, compressed and instant tea are reprocessed products; matcha defined as steamed, unrolled, shade-grown, finely ground tea powder

Orthodox black tea leaf grades: whole leaf OP, FOP, GFOP, TGFOP, FTGFOP, SFTGFOP; broken (BOP), fannings (BOPF, GFOF), dust (D1, PD); CTC has its own grades; grading is by leaf size and tip content, with no equivalence in China

Matcha grades ceremonial, premium, culinary by harvest (first, second, later), colour, texture; states there is no official Japanese standard and the terms are an export-market convention; wholesale price bands per kg

EU Combined Nomenclature 2026 chapter 09: 0901 coffee (not roasted / roasted, decaffeinated or not; husks and skins; substitutes containing coffee), 0902 tea (green, black and partly fermented, by pack size up to or over 3 kg), 0903 mate; spices follow

Directive 2000/36/EC sales names: cocoa butter; cocoa powder; fat-reduced cocoa; powdered chocolate; sweetened cocoa / drinking chocolate; chocolate (with couverture, gianduja, vermicelli, flakes); milk chocolate; family milk chocolate; white chocolate; filled chocolate; chocolate a la taza; pralines; labels state total dry cocoa solids

ICCO divides cocoa beans into fine or flavour and bulk or ordinary; Criollo and Trinitario generally fine, Forastero generally bulk with exceptions (Ecuador Nacional fine, Cameroon bulk); no single accepted criterion; difference is flavour, not other quality factors; definition in International Cocoa Agreement Article 2.2

German explainer of cocoa intermediates: Kakaomasse (liquor), Kakaobutter, Kakaopulver (at least 20 % cocoa butter) versus fettarmes / stark entölt (below 20 %, about 10-12 %), gesüsstes Kakaopulver and Schokoladenpulver, Kuvertüre (at least 35 % total cocoa solids, 31 % cocoa butter), nibs and shells, citing Kakaoverordnung and Directive 2000/36/EC

Callebaut professional catalogue by function: Chocolate (couvertures dark, milk, white, ruby, caramel), Cocoa ingredients (cocoa powder, cocoa butter, cocoa mass), Coatings and fillings, Nut ingredients, Inclusions (roasted cocoa nibs), Decorations, Toppings and sauces, Instants and mixes, Drinks

King Arthur Chocolate & Cocoa (22 items): filter Category Chocolate (10), Cocoa (6), Chocolate & Cocoa (2), Specialty (1), Spices & Pantry (3); products include Dutch-process Bensdorp, Black Cocoa, Double Dark Cocoa Blend, Burgundy Cocoa, Guittard and Valrhona chocolate, espresso powder

Yerba mate types axis: leaf and stem composition (con palo, despalada/sin palo), grind and dust, ageing (estacionada, suave, envejecida), drying (barbacuá smoked vs hot air), flavoured, compuesta (herb blends), organic, cocido and tea bags; chimarrão is a Brazilian fine bright-green grind

Six Chinese tea categories (green, yellow, dark, qing/oolong, white, red/black) by fermentation degree, process and liquor colour; proposed by Chen Chuan in 1979 (the page text seen in the search excerpt adds that it became an ISO standard in 2023)

Tao Tea Leaf (Toronto) menu: White, Green, Yellow, Black, Oolong, Rare Oolong, Pu-er, Ancient Tree Pu-er, Aged Tea, then Yerba Mate, Rooibos, Chai, Blooming, Iced Tea, Scented and Blend, Herbal, Caffeine-Free; mate, rooibos and herbal sit as sibling branches of true tea types

Adagio herbal page: herbal tea (tisane) defined as infusion of flowers, herbs, roots, bark, fruit or other plant material that is not Camellia sinensis; Rooibos, Decaf and Wellness are neighbouring collections; yerba mate and toasted mate are the caffeinated exception inside herbal; chamomile, chicoriccino, mate blends listed with customer scores

Kaldi Coffee Farm online store, coffee beans: sibling coffee categories coffee beans, drip coffee, iced, Cup of Excellence, equipment, gifts, flavoured, instant, liquid, regular (ground), milk/sugar/syrup; bean facets are Coffee type (straight: South America, Central America, Asia-Oceania, Africa-Middle East; blend), Roast (light, medium, medium-dark, dark, green/raw), Taste, Body; also certification lines (Bird Friendly, Fair Trade, Doi Tung, Woman's Hand)
Kaldi tea category 紅茶・お茶: black tea (82), Japanese-Chinese-health tea (41), herbal tea (38), instant (9), liquid (13); coffee, wine and baking are separate top-level groups on the same store

Kaldi baking category 製菓・製パン: flour and mixes, dairy-fats-butter, baking chocolate and cocoa (製菓用チョコレート・ココア, 4 items), syrups and liqueurs, flavourings, nuts and dried fruit, toppings, bakeware; cocoa for baking sits with baking, not with coffee and tea

Tchibo Kaffees menu mixes use-case and format: Kaffee für Vollautomaten, Espresso, Caffè Crema, Filterkaffee, Omni Roast, Entkoffeinierter Kaffee, Specialty Coffee von lokalen Röstereien, Kaffeekapseln, Kaffeepads, Instantkaffee; variants are Ganze Bohne / Gemahlen and pack size; products carry Intensität x/6 and taste tags (mild, fruchtig, nussig); Tee and equipment are sibling branches

Cup of Excellence rules (search excerpt gave the score thresholds, fetch gave the structure): national and international juries cup blind in six rounds, lots scoring 86+ advance and 87+ enter the online auction, 90+ get a Presidential Award, traceable to farm and micro-lot; a resale and collector channel for top lots

Kava.com buyer guide and shop: kava root powder is one product category beside tinctures, blends, sampler packs and accessories; quality is stated by variety (noble versus tudei), plant part (lateral root versus stem), kavalactone percentage (premium medium-grind about 5-12 %), origin (Fiji, Vanuatu, Hawaii, Solomon Islands), freshness and third-party lab test

New Mexico Tea Company pu-erh cakes: sub-branches All, Loose, Black (shou), Green (sheng), White, Dark tea; items named by cake name and weight (200 g, 250 g, 350 g, 357 g) with raw/ripe in the name, plus tuo cha shape

Pu-erh cake guide: first split raw sheng versus ripe shou, then ancient-tree (gushu), vintage, blended (pei fang) and single-origin cakes; collectable and aged stock with storage conditions and provenance; named factories Dayi, Xiaguan, Haiwan; resale channels and counterfeit warnings

Etsy criollo cacao market: raw cacao beans, ceremonial cacao paste blocks and cacao pods for germination are listed together; labelled by variety (criollo, forastero), origin (Peru, Mexico), raw or organic and weight

Single-origin coffee: from one known geographic origin as against blends; terms estate coffee and micro-lot or small-lot (single field, altitude band, harvest day); no universal rule or governing body enforces labels

Tea traditionally classified by degree or period of oxidation: green (steamed in Japan, pan-fired in China), yellow, white, oolong, black (orthodox graded by Orange Pekoe; CTC graded separately), post-fermented (pu-erh, liu bao); blended or flavoured teas are a further step
